protocol.archive_instructions: Archive baseline_commit, set DREVALPY_BASELINE_ROOT to that checkout, and invoke capture_v2_baseline.py with seed 0, 1 or 2.

scope: v2 port regression references; not upstream numerical parity
evidence: seed-N.json captures the eight low-level forward/_cmf operations in their original process order.
training.json captures predictions and selected checkpoint scores from actual predictor fits.
MOLIR training evidence uses one full six-row batch and was re-captured from baseline_commit on Linux x86_64; the other models were captured on macOS arm64.
training-corrections.json keeps verified defect-correction expectations separate from the immutable v2 fit baseline.
DIPK uses 512-wide gene/BIONIC and 768-wide MolGNet blocks.
SparseGO uses a valid two-level toy ontology with index-aligned genes.
